def minimum_total_cost():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().strip().split()
    
    A = list(map(int, data))
    
    # The minimum cost to complete all tasks
    min_cost = float('inf')
    
    # Iterate over each permutation of task completion order
    from itertools import permutations
    for perm in permutations(A):
        cost = 0
        previous = perm[0]
        for current in perm[1:]:
            cost += abs(current - previous)
            previous = current
        min_cost = min(min_cost, cost)
    
    print(min_cost)
